name: Sample Snapjaw Shell
summary: Across the Barrens, Sample Snapjaw Shells carry lingering vitality from freshwater oases. Tauren druids send them across the Great Sea to help heal Silverpine Forest.

sections.title: A Spark of Oasis Life
sections.body: Snapjaws thrive in the lush, strange oases of the Barrens. Their durable shells keep a faint inner glow and pulse with energy long after separation from the creature. Tauren druids watching the land's swift changes see in these carapaces the resilient spark of Kalimdor's wilderness. Their vigor shows how life can flourish even in harsh, arid surroundings.

sections.title: Healing Distant Lands
sections.body: Tauren naturalists send couriers across the sea with shells for Mura Runetotem at the Sepulcher. Stationed in Silverpine Forest's blighted expanses, Mura seeks ways to help the Forsaken heal the northlands. She studies the life-force preserved in the snapjaw's armor, hoping to find what can renew an ailing forest and bring growth back to dying soil.

faq.q: What makes this snapjaw shell special?
faq.answer: A Sample Snapjaw Shell keeps a faint inner glow and pulse of life long after collection. It comes from snapjaws around the Barrens' strange freshwater oases, where natural energies run unusually high.
Mura Runetotem, a tauren druid, needs the shell at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. She is there to help the Forsaken find ways to heal dying lands.

faq.q: Why send a Barrens shell all the way to Silverpine?
faq.answer: Silverpine's woodland is ailing and blighted, while life has suddenly surged at the Barrens oases and persisted. Druids hope the vitality in Kalimdor's beasts can teach them how to heal Lordaeron's damaged soil.

faq.q: Is the shell dangerous or tainted?
faq.answer: No. The shell radiates pure vitality rather than dark magic. The druids find the lingering energy in the Barrens' mysterious sudden growth natural resilience worth cultivating.

angles.text: For druids of the Cenarion Circle, studying oasis snapjaws offers crucial lessons in how life perseveres and how blighted ground might be healed.
As a tauren, you can see this shell's journey as a commitment to the Earth Mother. Your people carry aid and natural healing across the sea, even to their undead allies.
